name: ttderive-v1

steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m py_compile derive_v2.py && python -c "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlretrieve('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/munimtechnologies/ttbar-threshold-opendata/main/results/ttthresh-v2/results.json', '/out/results.json')" && sha256sum /out/results.json derive_v2.py derived_v2.csv | tee /out/sha256.txt
cd /work && python derive_v2.py /out/results.json --out /out/derived_machine.csv --check derived_v2.csv > /out/derive.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/derive.txt; exit $rc

paths.data: /data (docker volume mv2c-data-ttderive-none, kept for later jobs)
